title: Show filename extension for truncated filenames, like Dolphin does
line: Long file names on the desktop now keep their extension visible when shortened, like "Sample filename documen….docx", as Dolphin does.
explanation: Desktop and Folder View labels relied on Qt's plain right elision, so a long name lost its end, including the extension. Two files differing only in year and type (2002.docx, 2003.pdf) showed the same "Sample filename document fro…". Dolphin instead shortens the name before the extension. The change adds a FolderModel helper that lays out the label text the same way the label does and, when the last allowed line overflows, shortens only that line's name part and appends "…" plus the extension (MIME-aware, so .tar.gz stays whole); folders and names without an extension keep the old behaviour, and the tooltip still shows for shortened names.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: keep the file extension visible in elided labels

Long file names on the desktop were cut at the end, hiding the extension
that tells similar files apart, unlike Dolphin. Now the last line of the
label is shortened before the extension, so it reads like "name….pdf".

BUG: 447623

media.caption: Master: long names are cut at the end, both "Sample filename document fro…" look the same and the extensions are hidden.
Patched: the extension stays visible (….jpeg, ….tar.gz, ….docx, ….pdf); the folder and the extensionless file elide as before.
